headline: Iran claims attack on US bases in Kuwait and Bahrain
summary: The Iranian army says the strikes were part of 'Operation Lightning' targeting radar and defense systems.
details: Iran's army has claimed responsibility for attacks on US military radar and defense installations in Kuwait and Bahrain.
According to a statement released by the Iranian army, the strikes were part of the tenth phase of a retaliatory operation called 'Operation Lightning'.
In Kuwait, the army stated that they targeted the radar systems, Patriot defense systems, and fuel tanks at the Ali Al Salem base.
In a separate attack in Bahrain, the Iranian army claimed to have used drones to target communication systems, radar, Super Hawk radars, and Patriot installations at the Sheikh Isa base.

The Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps (IRGC) also claimed responsibility for the Kuwait attacks, stating they targeted C-RAM early warning radars and US troop assembly points at the Ali Al Salem airbase.

headline: 2 killed in bus-ambulance collision in Pabna
summary: The accident occurred on the Dhaka-Pabna highway in the Atikula area on Thursday morning.
details: Two people were killed and two others injured when a passenger bus and an ambulance collided in the Atikula area of Pabna.
The accident took place on Thursday morning at the Soradangi Koraitola area of the Dhaka-Pabna highway.
Police reported that the ambulance was transporting a body from Rajshahi to the Mahmudpur area of Santhia Upazila in Pabna.
The collision occurred when the ambulance met the 'Pabna Express' passenger bus, which was traveling from Dhaka to Pabna.
The ambulance driver, Raj, and a relative of the patient, Bulu Khatun, died on the spot.
Two other injured people were rescued and admitted to Pabna General Hospital.
Police have seized both the bus and the ambulance, but the bus driver and helper have fled the scene.
caption:
A tragic collision between a passenger bus and an ambulance in Pabna has left two people dead.

Two people were killed and two others injured when a passenger bus and an ambulance collided in the Atikula area of Pabna.

The accident took place on Thursday morning at the Soradangi Koraitola area of the Dhaka-Pabna highway.

Police reported that the ambulance was transporting a body from Rajshahi to the Mahmudpur area of Santhia Upazila in Pabna.

The collision occurred when the ambulance met the 'Pabna Express' passenger bus, which was traveling from Dhaka to Pabna.

The ambulance driver, Raj, and a relative of the patient, Bulu Khatun, died on the spot.

Two other injured people were rescued and admitted to Pabna General Hospital.

Police have seized both the bus and the ambulance, but the bus driver and helper have fled the scene.
